title: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab EE affecting all versions from 17.10 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and…
description: A vulnerability in GitLab EE versions from 17.10 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and 19.5 before 19.5.6 could allow an authenticated user to read CI/CD variable metadata from projects they do not have access to due to improper authorization in pipeline execution policies. The issue has been remediated in the specified fixed versions.
